_meta.name: Foreign-born population, decennial census
_meta.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Working Paper 81, Table 1
_meta.breaks: Alaska and Hawaii included from 1960; historical geography and nativity coverage vary.
_meta.note: Sixteen decennial observations from 1850–2000, not annual ACS. Published percentage in the foreign-born column. For 1850/1860 the source assumes enslaved people were native-born; 1890 excludes certain Indian Territory/reservation populations. 1970 uses the 15-percent sample.
